title: Maryland PSC Order No. 92523 (Case No. 9890)
text:
CORRECTED 
Maillog No. 332010
ORDER NO. 92523 
The 2027-2029 EmPOWER Maryland 
Program 
* 
* 
* 
* 
* 
* 
* 
BEFORE THE 
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
OF MARYLAND 
CASE NO. 9890 
Issue Date: July 10, 2026 
ORDER INITIATING NEW DOCKET 
FOR REVIEW OF THE 2027-2029 EmPOWER MARYLAND PROGRAM 
Pursuant to Public Utilities Article, Annotated Code of Maryland, §7-233(a), The 
Potomac Edison Company, Baltimore Gas and Electric Company, Delmarva Power & Light 
Company, Potomac Electric Power Company, and Southern Maryland Electric Cooperative, 
Inc., (collectively, the EmPOWER Utilities) will file their energy efficiency, conservation, and 
demand response plans for the 2027-2029 program cycle by September 1, 2026, for the 
Commission’s review. 
Pursuant to Public Utilities Article, Annotated Code of Maryland, §7-234(a), the 
Maryland Department of Housing and Community Development (“DHCD”) will file its energy 
efficiency and conservation plan for the 2027-2029 program cycle by September 1, 2026, for 
the Commission’s review. Pursuant to Order No. 92522, DHCD will file the alternative 
scenario plan by September 21, 2026. 
On October 26, 2026, the Commission will conduct a hearing on the fifth semi-annual 
reports for the 2024-2026 program cycle, and the Commission is currently planning to conduct 
a hearing on the 2027-2029 plans from October 26 through October 29.1 Accordingly, the 
1 Notices regarding the hearings will be issued at a later date. 

2 

Commission concludes that it will be more efficient and effective to open a new proceeding 
for the 2027-2029 EmPOWER Maryland programs, and a new docket, Case No. 9890, is hereby 
initiated for the review of the 2027-2029 plans. 
The Commission will continue to use the service list from Case No. 9705 for Case No. 
9890. Parties in the prior EmPOWER Maryland docket are requested to review the service list 
and provide any updates needed to the new docket’s (Case No. 9890) service list. The 
Commission directs all parties to file any reports or pleadings related to the 2024-2026 program 
cycle under Case No. 9705 and any plans, reports, or pleadings related to the 2027-2029 
program cycle under Case No. 9890. 
IT IS, THEREFORE, this 10th day of July in the year Two Thousand Twenty-Six, by 
the Maryland Public Service Commission, ORDERED: 
(1) 
that a new docket, Case No. 9890, is hereby initiated as set forth in this Order; 
(2) 
that the parties are directed to submit any changes or updates to the service list 
for Case No. 9890; 
(3) 
that the parties are directed to continue filing all EmPOWER Maryland 
pleadings for the 2024-2026 program cycle in Case No. 9890; and 
(4) 
that the parties are directed to file all EmPOWER Maryland pleadings for the 
2027-2029 program cycle in the new docket, Case No. 9890. 
By Direction of the Commission, 

/s/ Andrew S. Johnston 

Andrew S. Johnston 

Executive Secretary
